body.name: \widehat f_a
body.def: \(\widehat f_a(\tau)=\max\{n^{-1/4},\frac{\sum_i\mathbf1\{A_i=a\}\mathsf K_f((Y_i-\widehat q_a(\tau))/\omega_{a,n})/[(\widehat\pi_{a,-k(i)}(X_i)\vee\widehat b_{a,n})\omega_{a,n}]}{\sum_i\mathbf1\{A_i=a\}/(\widehat\pi_{a,-k(i)}(X_i)\vee\widehat b_{a,n})}\}\), with the ratio set to zero when its denominator is zero
